title: Campaign-site photographic and media census

researchScope.sourceMethod: Local campaign-site source trees and the published FairRentNYC 2019 Flickr-backed sheet were enumerated; every distinct local work and every Flickr photograph was visually reviewed in contact sheets.

publicationBoundary: This is a public-safe metadata census, not a gallery, rights clearance, creator-credit determination, consent determination, or placement decision. Exact local paths, Apple Photos identifiers, face metadata, and private coordinates are excluded.
limitations: Six local works could not be rendered and remain explicit unreadable gaps.
A content checksum deduplicates identical local files but does not establish that visually similar derivatives share one original.
Campaign-site publication supplies occurrence context, not photographer identity or unrestricted rights.
Apple Photos source binding and nearby-frame expansion remain a separate private research stage.
The 2019 FairRent sheet's general neighborhood, borough, and community-district fields are retained; exact coordinates are deliberately excluded.
